primary_task: Provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals and Agent Identities via the Microsoft Graph beta API.

requirements.name: provisioning-runtime
requirements.evidence: PowerShell (Install-Module Microsoft.Graph.Beta...) or Python (pip install azure-identity requests)
requirements.check: command -v pwsh ; apt-get -s install powershell ; command -v python3
requirements.observed: pwsh absent, apt: Unable to locate package powershell; python3 present

requirements.name: azure.identity
requirements.observed: No module named azure; azure_identity-1.26.0 wheel

requirements.name: az
requirements.check: command -v az ; apt-get -s install azure-cli ; pip download --no-deps azure-cli
requirements.observed: absent; apt: Unable to locate package; azure_cli-2.90.0 wheel downloadable

requirements.name: AZURE_TENANT_ID/AZURE_CLIENT_ID/AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
requirements.check: [ -n "${AZURE_TENANT_ID:-}" ] && echo set || echo unset (and CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_SECRET)

requirements.name: entra-signed-in-user (az login / Connect-MgGraph)
requirements.evidence: Get sponsor user ID ... use az CLI: az ad signed-in-user show
requirements.check: az absent; no Azure credentials in env

requirements.name: graph.microsoft.com
requirements.evidence: All endpoints use base URL: https://graph.microsoft.com/beta

requirements.name: microsoft-docs
requirements.evidence: Search microsoft-docs MCP for the latest Agent ID documentation

notes: microsoft-docs MCP is a 'Before you start' doc-verification step, treated as non-hard (also unavailable). Sidecar/Docker material lives in references and is not part of the core provisioning workflow.
